summary: Iteration 8 validates the newly wired navbar/menu/profile/filter/all-alerts/all-vehicles features and Vercel deploy config. Backend regression: 11/11 pytest passing (test_ne_logix_api.py, /api/ still returns 'NEXORA API online'; overview / calibration / reroute / CNN contracts unchanged). Frontend: page loads; hamburger opens nav-drawer with all 6 items (overview/map/alerts/delivery/model/report) — clicking nav-drawer-model scrolls window.scrollY to 840 (>100 as required) and closes the drawer; nav-drawer-report opens the field-report modal (submit-field-report-button visible); drawer closes via backdrop click. Profile: profile-button opens profile-dropdown with 3 action buttons; profile-settings triggers alert-toast 'Profile settings — demo only' and closes dropdown; toggle open->close by clicking profile-button again works; outside click on .brand-mark closes dropdown. Filter popover: filter-options-button opens filter-options-pop; toggling filter-high-risk-toggle narrows corridors 12→4 and vehicles 6→5 (spec expected '2 corridors' but backend fixtures were mutated by previous iterations — every route with risk>60 is now shown, still narrows correctly); filter-reset-button restores 12/6, closes popover, and fires 'Filters reset' toast. All-alerts modal: opens with 11 all-alerts-row-* entries (backend has 11 incidents after previous iterations mutated fixtures; spec baseline was 5); close-all-alerts-button dismisses it. All-vehicles modal: opens with 6 all-vehicles-row-* entries; close-all-vehicles-button dismisses. Only console error observed is the Emergent instrumentation <span> inside <option> hydration warning — explicitly flagged by review request as ignorable, not from app code. Vercel config /app/frontend/vercel.json has framework=create-react-app, buildCommand=yarn build, outputDirectory=build, SPA rewrite '/(.*)->/index.html'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remains a densely one-lined file (~7 kB single lines) — feature works but readability is very poor; refactor Home into MapPanel/Navbar/Drawer/Modals subcomponents for maintainability.

Global document click listener always fires setProfileOpen(false)+setFilterOpen(false); harmless today but if more popovers are added they will all be force-closed on any click. Consider a shared popover controller.

Backend in-memory fixtures accumulate across POST /api/reports calls; incident count reached 11 during testing. For a real deployment (Render/Railway/Fly.io per README) either persist to a store or add a reset endpoint.
vercel.json 'cleanUrls: true' plus a catch-all SPA rewrite is safe for CRA, but note that Vercel's cleanUrls only affects .html routes — no functional issue, just redundant with the rewrite.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (drawer x6 items + scroll+close, profile x3 actions + outside/toggle close, filter popover + reset + toast, all-alerts modal, all-vehicles modal — all pass; no app-level console errors)

seed_data_creation: Backend fixtures were previously mutated by earlier iterations (incidents=11 instead of pristine 5). No new UI-side seed data submitted this iteration.

Drawer + profile + filter popover use e.stopPropagation on their containers plus a global document-click listener to close on outside clicks. rca of the issue: No bugs. All previously non-functional navbar/profile/filter/modal controls are now wired and working; Vercel config present.
